<!-- The features as rows: text beside a picture (the rows layout of FeatureGrid). Icons are Lucide names. -->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Feature } from "../blocks/feature-grid.types";

export type FeatureRowsProps = {
  features: Feature[];
  mediaSide?: "end" | "start" | "alternate";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const { features, mediaSide = "end" } = defineProps<FeatureRowsProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Stack gap="8" align="stretch" data-testid="feature-rows">
    <Grid
      v-for="feature in features"
      :key="feature.id"
      cols="1-2"
      class="group items-center gap-8"
      data-testid="feature-card"
    >
      <Stack gap="2" class="min-w-0">
        <LucideIcon :name="feature.icon" :size="24" />
        <Title :as="3" size="xl" weight="bold">
          {{ feature.title }}
        </Title>
        <Text size="base" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ feature.text }}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
      <Box
        :class="cn(
          'w-full min-w-0',
          (
            (mediaSide as string) === 'start' ? 'md:order-first'
            : (mediaSide as string) === 'alternate' ? 'md:group-even:order-first'
            : ''
          )
        )"
      >
        <MediaFrame :alt="feature.title" ratio="4/3" />
      </Box>
    </Grid>
  </Stack>
</template>
